member.name: T:ktsu.DeepClone.IDeepCloneable
member.summary: Interface for objects that can be deep cloned.
member.remarks:
When implementing this interface:
Create a new instance of the same type
Copy all fields and properties to the new instance
For reference types, call DeepClone() on those objects when copying
Handle circular references carefully to avoid infinite recursion
Consider using the base class for easier implementation

member.name: M:ktsu.DeepClone.IDeepCloneable.DeepClone
member.summary: Creates a deep clone of the current instance.
member.returns: A new instance that is a deep clone of the current instance.
member.remarks: This non-generic method should typically delegate to a generic implementation. For example: public object DeepClone() => DeepClone(); where the other DeepClone() method is the strongly-typed version.
